受.meaning: A <part>claw</part> reaches down from above, holding out a warm <part>blanket</part>. Below, a hand twisted like a <part>pretzel</part> reaches up and takes it. 'Thank you,' it says. Some gifts you just <kanji>accept</kanji>.
受.on: The whole <sound>ju</sound>ry claps as the blanket is handed down.
受.kun: '<sound>Oo</sound>!' you coo, wrapping yourself up in the blanket you just received.

暖.meaning: An arcade <part>claw machine</part> sits out in the <part>sun</part>. You drop in a coin, and the claw grabs not a teddy but a ray of sunshine, and drops it in your lap. You glow all over with <kanji>warmth</kanji>.
暖.on: Carry that sunshine down into a damp <sound>dun</sound>geon, and even the rats cuddle up to it.
暖.kun: '<sound>Ah</sound>!' sigh the rats, toasting a <sound>ta</sound>co in the sunbeam, then a second <sound>ta</sound>co.

校.meaning: Under a big <part>tree</part>, children from every street <part>mingle</part>: they swap snacks and chase each other, then line up when the bell rings. The tree's shade is the classroom. It's a <kanji>school</kanji>.
校.on: At break time, everyone gets an ice cream <sound>co</sound>ne.

良.meaning: A <part>robot</part> wakes up with a shiny dot of light on its head. It washes the dishes, walks the dog and helps an old lady across the road. The light glows green: <kanji>good</kanji>.
良.on: As a reward, the robot gets a night at a <sound>ryo</sound>kan, with slippers on all its feet.
良.kun: It even shares its <sound>yo</sound>gurt with the dog. Good robot.

素.meaning: A curious kid takes apart a <part>TV antenna</part> and a spool of <part>thread</part> to see what's inside: just wire, just fluff. The plainest bits that things are made of, lesson one: <kanji>elementary</kanji>.
素.on: She lays all the bare bits out on a squashy <sound>so</sound>fa.
素.kun: Then she builds them back up from the bottom: a <sound>mo</sound>le hill first, a <sound>to</sound>tem pole on top. Back to the source.

改.meaning: A grumpy <part>cobra</part> hisses at everyone, until a teacher sits it down and waves a <part>fan</part> under its nose, day after day, lesson after lesson. Now it says please and thank you. What a <kanji>reformation</kanji>.
改.on: To celebrate, the cobra flies a <sound>ki</sound>te with a smiley face on it.
改.kun: '<sound>Ah</sound>!' gasp its friends, '<sound>Rah</sound>-rah!' cheer the snakes, and the new cobra bows over a plate of <sound>ta</sound>cos.
